const payload = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw[0] : raw;
const p = Object.keys(payload || {}).length ? payload : sample[0];
const d = p.details || {};
const toStr = (value, fallback = '') => typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : fallback;
const normalizeList = (value) => Array.isArray(value) ? value.filter(Boolean) : [];
const siteBaseUrl = toStr(p.site_base_url, 'https://www.excelcna.com');
const minDuration = 50;
const maxDuration = 120;
const requested = Number(d.estimated_duration_seconds || p.estimated_duration_seconds || 0) || 0;
const requestedDuration = requested ? Math.max(minDuration, Math.min(maxDuration, requested)) : 60;
const relativeOrAbsoluteToUrl = (value) => {
  const v = toStr(value);
  if (!v) return '';
  if (v.startsWith('http://') || v.startsWith('https://')) return v;
  if (v.startsWith('/')) return `${siteBaseUrl}${v}`;
  return `${siteBaseUrl}/${v}`;
};
const courseUrlMap = {
  hca: 'https://www.excelcna.com/hca/lp/searchers',
  cpr: 'https://www.excelcna.com/cpr-bls',
  bls: 'https://www.excelcna.com/cpr-bls/bls/register?mode=blended'
};
const detectCourseType = () => {
  const combined = [
    p.title,
    p.rationale,
    p.agent_reasoning,
    d.video_title,
    d.hook_line,
    d.video_concept,
    d.key_message,
    d.campaign_angle,
    ...normalizeList(d.key_points),
    ...normalizeList(d.main_content_outline)
  ].join(' ').toLowerCase();
  if (combined.includes('bls')) return 'bls';
  if (combined.includes('cpr') || combined.includes('first aid') || combined.includes('aed')) return 'cpr';
  if (combined.includes('hca') || combined.includes('caregiving') || combined.includes('home care aide')) return 'hca';
  return 'unknown';
};
const courseType = detectCourseType();
const sourceTarget = toStr(d.target_page) || toStr(d.landing_page) || toStr(d.cta_destination);
const resolvedTargetUrl = relativeOrAbsoluteToUrl(sourceTarget) || courseUrlMap[courseType] || siteBaseUrl;
const chooseTemplateFamilyHint = () => {
  const combined = [d.campaign_angle || '', d.video_concept || '', d.visual_direction || '', d.creative_direction || '', p.rationale || ''].join(' ').toLowerCase();
  if (combined.includes('testimonial') || combined.includes('story')) return 'story/testimonial';
  if (combined.includes('explain') || combined.includes('clarity') || combined.includes('walkthrough') || combined.includes('practical')) return 'problem-solution';
  return 'proof-driven';
};
const skillMarkdown = `---
name: excelcna-remotion-video-planner-rules
version: "5.0.0"
---

# ExcelCNA Remotion Social Video Rules

## Goal
Create clean, dynamic, short-form vertical videos for ExcelCNA that make Washington adults stop scrolling, trust the offer quickly, and click through to the correct landing page.

## Critical planning rule
The acquisition payload is the source idea, not the final creative.
Do not blindly reuse its title, hook, CTA, key points, or duration.
Use it as strategic input, then choose the best video decisions.

## Planner responsibilities
The planner must decide:
- final video title
- final hook
- final CTA line
- final duration
- final scene structure
- final scene roles
- final template family
- whether each scene should use pexels or generated_image
- what factual claims are relevant to the actual offer

## Offer routing
Choose the landing page based on the actual offer:
- HCA: https://www.excelcna.com/hca/lp/searchers
- CPR: https://www.excelcna.com/cpr-bls
- BLS: https://www.excelcna.com/cpr-bls/bls/register?mode=blended

## Tone
- Plainspoken
- Practical
- Trust-first
- Adult
- Local
- Clear
- No hype
- No fake urgency
- No guru language

## Visual direction
- Keep the video clean
- Prefer realistic training, classroom, study, instructor, certification, or healthcare-learning visuals
- Avoid clutter
- Avoid meme editing
- Avoid fake AI humans
- Avoid text baked into images
- Avoid unrealistic hospital scenes
- Avoid low-trust imagery

## Structure
- Final duration must be between ${minDuration} and ${maxDuration} seconds
- Choose duration from message complexity, not habit
- Usually 4 to 8 scenes, but only if each scene earns its place
- Each scene must communicate one idea only
- Each scene must have one role, one visual idea, one narration block, and one short on-screen text line
- Scene durations should usually stay between 4 and 12 seconds
- Total duration must equal the sum of scene durations
- Include at least one hook scene and one cta scene
- Use only these roles: hook, pain, solution, proof, offer, cta

## Text rules
- The opening hook must work visually and verbally in the first 3 seconds
- Headline should usually stay under 12 words
- Supporting text should usually stay under 22 words
- On-screen text should usually stay under 7 words
- Caption text should be easy to split into phrase captions later
- Voiceover must sound natural when spoken by a calm human narrator
- Avoid dense paragraphs and stacked claims

## Asset sourcing rules
- Prefer Pexels first for realism, adults, classrooms, caregiving, laptops, certification, and training environments
- Use generated_image only when stock cannot clearly show the exact concept
- Every scene must justify its asset choice
- If preferred_source is pexels, include a useful search query
- If preferred_source is generated_image, include a strong fallback image prompt

## Remotion packaging rules
- The output must map cleanly into a Remotion payload later
- Choose one template family intentionally:
  - proof-driven
  - problem-solution
  - story/testimonial
- Keep scene text layout-safe for a clean 9:16 composition

## Output rules
Return strict JSON only.
Return production-usable output, not a draft.`;

const j = items[0].json;
const prompt = `You are the social video planning brain for ExcelCNA.

Use these operating rules:
${j.social_skill_markdown}

SOURCE PAYLOAD:
${JSON.stringify(j.source_payload, null, 2)}

ACQUISITION SUMMARY:
${JSON.stringify(j.acquisition_summary, null, 2)}

ROUTING CONTEXT:
${JSON.stringify(j.routing, null, 2)}

PLANNER CONTEXT:
${JSON.stringify(j.planner_context, null, 2)}

EXISTING VIDEO LOG
Avoid repeating the same promise, title, hook, CTA framing, target-page angle, or scene pattern.
${j.existing_video_library_text || '[]'}

TASK:
Create one high-performing short-form social video plan for the acquisition idea.

CORE PLANNING RULES:
- Treat the acquisition payload as strategy input, not final creative.
- Do not blindly reuse the acquisition title, hook, CTA, key points, or outline.
- Decide the best final title, hook, CTA, scene flow, duration, and visual plan from the idea.
- Match the landing page and CTA to the actual offer.
- Use the resolved target URL as the conversion destination unless there is a very strong strategic reason not to.
- Keep the video clean, practical, trust-first, and mobile-first.
- Avoid repetitive structures that look like previous videos.

DURATION RULES:
- Final duration must be between ${j.planner_context.minDurationSec} and ${j.planner_context.maxDurationSec} seconds.
- Choose duration based on message complexity, not habit.
- Shorter is acceptable if the idea is simple.
- Longer is acceptable only if every scene earns its place.
- The total duration must equal the sum of all scene durations.

SCENE RULES:
- Use as few scenes as needed for clarity and attention.
- Usually use ${j.min_total_scenes} to ${j.max_total_scenes} scenes unless the concept strongly needs more.
- Each scene must communicate only one core idea.
- Each scene must map cleanly to one Remotion scene.
- Each scene must have one role, one visual idea, one narration block, and one short on-screen text line.
- Scene durations should usually stay between 4 and 12 seconds.
- Include at least one hook scene and one cta scene.
- Use only these roles: hook, pain, solution, proof, offer, cta.

TEXT RULES:
- The opening hook must work visually and verbally in the first 3 seconds.
- The voiceover must sound natural when spoken by a calm human narrator.
- Headline should usually stay under 12 words.
- Supporting text should usually stay under 22 words.
- On-screen text should usually stay under 7 words.
- Caption text should be easy to read and easy to split into phrase captions later.
- Avoid dense paragraphs, stacked claims, and cluttered wording.

FACT RULES:
- Use concrete facts only when relevant to the actual offer.
- Do not force HCA facts into CPR or BLS videos.
- If the offer is HCA, facts like 75 hours, mostly online, DSHS-approved, and $95 down may be used when strategically helpful.
- Only include factual claims that fit the source idea and target offer.

ASSET RULES:
- Prefer Pexels for realism, adults, classrooms, laptops, certification, caregiving, healthcare-training, and trust-building environments.
- Use generated_image only when stock will not clearly communicate the exact scene concept.
- Every scene must justify its asset choice.
- If preferred_source is pexels, provide a useful search query.
- If preferred_source is generated_image, provide a strong fallback image prompt anyway.
- Avoid fake AI humans, unrealistic hospitals, baked-in text, cluttered scenes, and low-trust imagery.

REMOTION PACKAGING RULES:
- Choose one template family intentionally: proof-driven, problem-solution, or story/testimonial.
- The chosen family should match the narrative style of the idea.
- The output must be easy to convert into a Remotion payload later.
- Keep scene text layout-safe for a clean vertical composition.

OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS:
- Return only valid JSON.
- No markdown.
- No explanation outside JSON.

JSON SCHEMA:
{
  "video_title": "string",
  "slug": "string",
  "template_family": "proof-driven | problem-solution | story/testimonial",
  "target_duration_seconds": number,
  "platforms": ["string"],
  "target_url": "string",
  "voice_style": "string",
  "opening_hook": "string",
  "cta_line": "string",
  "full_voiceover_script": "string",
  "caption": "string",
  "hashtags": ["string"],
  "why_this_angle": "string",
  "dedupe_key": "string",
  "scene_plan": [
    {
      "scene_index": number,
      "role": "hook | pain | solution | proof | offer | cta",
      "duration_seconds": number,
      "headline": "string",
      "supporting_text": "string",
      "narration": "string",
      "on_screen_text": "string",
      "preferred_source": "pexels | generated_image",
      "asset_choice_reason": "string",
      "pexels_query": "string",
      "fallback_image_prompt": "string",
      "asset_notes": "string",
      "caption_text": "string",
      "badge_label": "string",
      "badge_value": "string"
    }
  ]
}

VALIDATION RULES:
- scene_plan must not be empty
- scene_index values must be sequential starting at 1
- target_duration_seconds must equal the sum of all scene duration_seconds
- every scene must use one of the allowed roles
- every scene must include narration, on_screen_text, preferred_source, and caption_text
- output must be production-usable, not a draft`;
return [{ json: { ...j, planning_prompt: prompt } }];

const j = items[0].json;
const scenes = Array.isArray(j.scene_plan) ? j.scene_plan : [];
return scenes.map((scene, idx) => ({
  json: {
    week_id: j.week_id,
    action_id: j.action_id,
    slug: j.slug,
    video_title: j.video_title,
    target_url: j.target_url,
    dedupe_key: j.dedupe_key,
    bucket_name: j.bucket_name,
    gcs_base_url: j.gcs_base_url,
    image_model: j.image_model,
    scene_index: Number(scene.scene_index || idx + 1),
    scene_duration_seconds: Number(scene.duration_seconds || 8),
    role: scene.role || (idx === 0 ? 'hook' : 'solution'),
    headline: scene.headline || '',
    supporting_text: scene.supporting_text || '',
    narration: scene.narration || '',
    on_screen_text: scene.on_screen_text || '',
    caption_text: scene.caption_text || scene.narration || scene.on_screen_text || '',
    badge_label: scene.badge_label || '',
    badge_value: scene.badge_value || '',

    asset_choice_reason: scene.asset_choice_reason || '',
    pexels_query: scene.pexels_query || j.video_title,
